uthmani: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أُجِبْتُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ

moshaf_used_for_reference.note: QDAT reciters are lay students recorded over WhatsApp, not a canonical qari - no single 'correct' moshaf edition applies. Used generic/commonly-taught Hafs defaults for locating rule positions. Exact madd length numbers may need re-checking against how QDAT experts actually graded 'correct'.

madd_munfasil.context: لَنَ + [اااا] + إِنَّ — alif madd at end of لَنَا stretched before hamza of إِنَّ
madd_munfasil.how_to_check: count repeated madd-length characters at/near this position in predicted phonemes vs QDAT correct/incorrect label; NOT a sifat attribute, it's a phoneme-repeat-count signal (as used in gate0_muaalem.py)

ghunnah.how_to_check: sifat.ghonna attribute at this position: expect 'maghnoon' for correct recitation

ikhfa.context: noon sakinah before ت in أَنتَ (anta) - model uses a DISTINCT phonetic symbol ڻ (not regular ن) for the nasalized ikhfa sound
ikhfa.how_to_check: two signals: (1) sifat.ghonna at this position (expect 'maghnoon'), (2) whether predicted phoneme symbol at this position is ڻ (ikhfa-nasalized) vs ن (plain, i.e. izhar - the actual mistake) vs missing entirely
